versions.content: Justification for the existence of attributes Application- ArrayDataType . dynamicArraySizeProfile and ApplicationArrayEle- ment . arraySizeHandling At the first glance, the two attributes ApplicationAr- rayDataType . dynamicArraySizeProfile and ApplicationArrayElement . arraySizeHandling seem equivalent. However, both are needed because they have to be used if multi dimensional variable size arrays have to be described. In this case, multiple combinations of sizes could occur which cannot be specified beforehand.
